caption: The video captures a forest waterfall scene in which multiple white cascades pour continuously down into a deep turquoise pool. The falling water streaks downward frame after frame, its spray patterns shifting as the streams descend the dark rock face. At the base of the right-hand cascade, a mound of splash and foam expands and collapses irregularly against the pool's edge. In the foreground, white rapids churn and break, with foam patches merging, splitting, and drifting across the surface. Subtle ripples move across the calm turquoise water near the impact zones of the falls. Leafy green branches frame the right side of the view while slender vines hang along the left. A moss-covered rock rests at the right edge of the pool, staying fixed as the water rushes past it.
relations: Falling water streaks down the dark rock face, generating shifting spray patterns as it descends continuously.
Splash and foam at the right cascade's base expand and collapse irregularly against the pool's edge.
White rapids in the foreground churn and break, with foam patches merging, splitting, and drifting.
A moss-covered rock, leafy branches, and hanging vines remain fixed while water rushes and ripples past.
